unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 (github.com/spendmarshal/MachineNativeEconomy/issues/1): "Add Nano (XNO) as a settlement rail in the any payment rail control plane". Argued in its own README terms: every rail it lists (x402, MPP, L402, AP2, Visa, Mastercard) is vendor-bundled custody+policy+one rail -> Nano has no vendor bundle, the block IS the gateway receipt so a month-end statement needs no provider reconciliation; AgentAccount/ReceiptRegistry capability chain stays. Named a Nano rail backend beside x402/MPP. Carried nano-invoice + extract.paypercall.dev. Verified open under dhyabi2.
